verdict.rationale: Devin's own docs say you can ask it in natural language to "repro and fix bugs", tag it on Slack or Teams threads about a bug, and work with it through a conversational interface. Ask Devin answers questions about code structure, and Auto-Fix iterates on flagged bugs and CI failures. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the debugging/troubleshooting workflow itself, and independent hands-on corroboration of debugging quality (community comments mention it looping on hard tasks but do not concretely contradict the capability).

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug issues and troubleshoot using natural-language queries
